restaurant_name: คลินิกเป็นสุข ( ตรวจโรคทั่วไปในเด็กและผู้ใหญ่ )
text: Doctor was extremely unfriendly and didn't listen to our (the parents) explanation. Waste of time if the doctor doesn't listen. Next time we'll go to Siriroj Hospital again where the service seems very competent and is much friendlier.

restaurant_name: คลินิกเป็นสุข ( ตรวจโรคทั่วไปในเด็กและผู้ใหญ่ )
text: I came to get a medical certificate for my driver's license. The price was cheap, the service was good, and it was fast. I came at 3 PM and it was done in no time. It was excellent!

restaurant_name: คลินิกเป็นสุข ( ตรวจโรคทั่วไปในเด็กและผู้ใหญ่ )
text:
I've read many reviews, and they all mention the same problem: the doctor has a very rude attitude. Please read these reviews and improve. P.S. Today, I took my child for a check-up. My child simply stuck their foot on the table. Because children are restless, it's normal for them to fidget. The doctor looked at my child and said, "Don't stick your foot out like that, people will say you have no manners." Was the doctor trying to reprimand or teach the child? I was shocked by the doctor's words. Not only did the doctor lack manners in speaking to patients, but they also lacked psychological skills in treating and communicating with children.
The doctor also said that the clinic is closing earlier these days, from 8 PM to 7 PM, because there are fewer patients and people drive fast on the road passing by. This doesn't seem related. After reading the reviews, it seems to be the doctor's fault. There are many good, skilled, and psychologically skilled doctors in Phuket who can effectively communicate with children. You should consider your own shortcomings based on these reviews. #Sticking your foot out like that, people will say you have no manners. Is this something you should be saying to a kindergarten child?
author_name: อุทุมพร คําหารพล

restaurant_name: คลินิกเป็นสุข ( ตรวจโรคทั่วไปในเด็กและผู้ใหญ่ )
text:
The doctor was incredibly frustrating to talk to. I don't know what he was talking about. Even when he asked if I'd been here before, I said no, it was my first and only time. Each question he asked was like, "What kind of answer are you looking for?" He didn't listen to anything I said. Did he want me to answer only what he thought? I went to the clinic because it's quick and convenient, but even doctors at the hospital speak better than this.
And then he said he wasn't a pediatrician and couldn't cure every disease. Close the clinic if you're not one of those doctors! Why put up that sign if you're not one of those doctors? The price is expensive, I have the money to pay. Don't act like this. I didn't get a free checkup, I have money.

restaurant_name: คลินิกเป็นสุข ( ตรวจโรคทั่วไปในเด็กและผู้ใหญ่ )
text: Honestly, we just posted that it wasn't okay to make our child wait outside because they were sick. But the clinic staff told us to go to the hospital instead. We asked if they wouldn't provide service there, and they said yes. When we tried to film their response, they walked away. It was awful. We didn't even get to say anything.

restaurant_name: คลินิกเป็นสุข ( ตรวจโรคทั่วไปในเด็กและผู้ใหญ่ )
text: The doctor's attitude was terrible. The service at the counter was good, but the doctor's words were unpleasant. Once is enough. The price is okay, I have the money to pay.

restaurant_name: คลินิกเป็นสุข ( ตรวจโรคทั่วไปในเด็กและผู้ใหญ่ )
text: The doctor examined well. But!!!! I don't like the way the doctor spoke. My child was cranky and crying. The doctor was fierce and very aggressive. He wasn't very friendly to children. Goodbye. I won't go. It's expensive, but you should speak to children better.

restaurant_name: คลินิกเป็นสุข ( ตรวจโรคทั่วไปในเด็กและผู้ใหญ่ )
text: The doctor was unpleasant, unfriendly, and had a very negative attitude. One visit was enough. It was expensive and the service was terrible.
